mode: SUPERVISED, requested in chat: the service drafts' URL keys (slugs) must match the live service links in the navigation.
why_allowed: WordPress does not enforce slug uniqueness for drafts (wp_unique_post_slug returns draft slugs unchanged), so a draft can hold the same key as the live post; the live posts are untouched.
go_live_note: At go-live the old live post must still be renamed/drafted BEFORE the draft is published, otherwise WordPress suffixes the new post to <slug>-2. Publishing one of these drafts from wp-admin directly, while the live page is still published, would produce the -2 URL.
not_ours: 12127, 12133, 12223-12226 are older manual "(DRAFT)" posts (unstamped, now drafts) with *-draft / *-draft-blocks slugs; they are not going live and were not changed.
incident: The first batch errored on get_sample_permalink() (an admin-only function) AFTER renaming 12239; state was read back, and the remaining five were renamed in two further calls, each guarded on the expected current slug.
verified: Logged out: the six live URLs still serve the live posts (none serves a draft). Logged in (Chrome, own tab group, closed): /services/cnc-micro-machining-services/ -> post 11893, /services-applications/ -> page 9970 (live, not the drafts); previews ?p=12239 and ?page_id=12371 open the drafts.
specs: spec.yaml slugs stay pl-auto-* (build-time slug; validate_spec --automation requires the namespace at build). The go-live slug is recorded in build-state.json as planned_live_url.
